title: Customers reporting sizing inconsistencies across multiple items
situation: Multiple customers are reporting that items do not match the expected fit, which may lead to high return rates if not addressed.
hypothesis: Inconsistent sizing standards for current inventory

params.reply_en: We are sorry to hear the item did not fit as expected. Please initiate a return through your account, and we will process a full refund for you.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن عدم ملاءمة المقاس لك. يرجى طلب استرجاع المنتج من خلال حسابك، وسنقوم بمعالجة استرداد المبلغ بالكامل لك.

actions.why: Provide clear instructions for returns to resolve the sizing dissatisfaction.

actions.title: Sizing feedback process
actions.answer_en: If an item does not fit, please use the return portal in your account to send it back for a full refund.
actions.answer_ar: إذا كان المقاس غير مناسب، يرجى استخدام بوابة الاسترجاع في حسابك لإعادة المنتج واسترداد المبلغ بالكامل.

params.note: Multiple reports of items running smaller than labeled. Please review size charts for these products.

actions.why: Alert the catalog team to investigate potential sizing discrepancies.
